weather_report:
As evening settles over Boston, a gentle coolness blankets the city, with the temperature hovering near a crisp 33 degrees. The sky presents a patchwork of partly cloudy skies, offering hints of the stars while keeping a veil of mystery alive. With a modest northwest wind whispering at about 8 mph, the air is invigorating, ideal for a reflective stroll through the quieter streets or a solitary moment on a park bench.

Looking ahead to Monday, expect the sun to grace the day with its warming rays, promising a high near 50 before the temperature begins to dip in the afternoon. As the daylight unfolds, the atmosphere will become radiant, offering a lovely backdrop for any outdoor plans. Dress in layers to accommodate the transition from the cool morning to the more temperate afternoon, perhaps donning a cozy scarf alongside a light jacket. With the allure of sunny skies, consider a leisurely walk along the Charles River, stopping at a favorite café for a warm drink as you absorb the vibrant energy of the city, inviting all senses into the embrace of this November day.
